quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi

dialogue.t: Ooh, see that poster over there? Looks like the Korolevskiy Troupe is putting on a new ballet!
"Black Snow Swan"...? Huh. That's an interesting name. Aren't Snow Swans usually white?
Looks like the person playing the lead is...
Please come to your senses, Miss Odette. There's no way you can get all this done in time.
That's Vodyanitsa's voice, isn't it? Sounds like it came from over there.
The premiere is only two weeks away. Why are you still taking on Fatui missions? What about the rehearsals or the meet-and-greets here at the theater?
I doubt either of those will take up the whole day, and even if they do, there's still time at night.
You mean when you're supposed to be eating dinner or sleeping? Which one are you planning to skip this time?
Neither. I made this decision based on objective knowledge of my own abilities, not—
Oh, um, sorry! We didn't mean to eavesdrop. It's just, things sounded a little heated over here, so we came to check.
{NICKNAME} and Paimon! Perfect timing! Help me talk some sense into Odette, please.
Nothing.
Uh huh, right. Just our prima ballerina running herself into the ground again! You saw the poster outside, right? Odette's starring in the "Black Snow Swan" in two weeks.
And let me tell you, this ballet is a real test of a dancer's technical skill and their emotional understanding of the character.
But just as rehearsal time's getting tight, Odette's gone and accepted a monster-slaying mission from the Fatui.

Who knows how long that's gonna take? It's not like monster-hunting is a walk in the park either! What if this causes problems during the final performance, and people start sending complaints to the Theater?
Huh, could you explain the situation to the Fatui, maybe? Just say you didn't know how tight the rehearsal schedule was gonna get.
You misunderstand. I applied to work with the Fatui with full knowledge of said schedule.
Huh!? Why would you do that?

dialogue.sit: (Doesn't seem like she really wants to talk about it...)

dialogue.t: All that matters is that I'm confident I can do both.
*sigh*... Forget it. You win. But if someone comes looking for you, and you're nowhere to be found... I'm not covering for you this time.

dialogue.sit: Since Odette's mind is made up...
Maybe it's better to think about how we can help instead...

dialogue.t: Yeah, we know you're just looking out for her, Vodyanitsa, but it seems like she's got her heart set on doing both...
I knew it was a lost cause... Just do me a favor and at least let someone else help manage your schedule, okay, Odette?
I can do that on my—
What was that?
...Alright.
Very well.
That was quick!
We already know he(she)'s trustworthy from back when we were trapped in the Theater.
Besides, he(she)'s dealt with many Harbingers and is familiar with how the Fatui operate. I'm sure he(she)'s up to the task.
Hmph...
You picked {NICKNAME} when I'm standing right here? We've known each other for way longer!
That's true, and whether it's through the Theater or the Rokot you know I'm always happy to work with you.
But if I left this up to you, you'd set aside too much time for rest... or drag me out to go shopping and buy snacks.
Well, that's because rest is a necessity.
To you, everything is a "necessity."
Well, there are too many fun things worth trying in this world! I'm not just gonna let them pass me by!
Are there? I never noticed.
Hmph, of course not. You never let your eyes stray from what's right in front of you.
It's only natural for one's eyes to stare straight ahead.
And that is why friends are so important. Each friend is like an extra pair of eyes.
So, she's all yours, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! I trust your "vision," hehe.

dialogue.sit: We'll make sure the proper arrangements are made.

dialogue.t: Good. Then, since you've agreed to put {NICKNAME} in charge of your schedule, you better listen to him(her) and follow it, Odette!
Okay, I promise.
Hmph... that's more like it. Alright, it's all up to you then. The schedule planner is over there, so fill it out whenever you're ready.
Remember, the premiere for the Black Snow Swan is in two weeks.
The Fatui mission assessment is in one week, so do factor that in as well.
Okay! Leave it to us!
Wait a second... does this make us your managers for the next two weeks?
Hm, I suppose. Here's to the start of a successful working relationship, then.
I'm leaving Odette in your hands, okay? Try to keep a close eye on her and don't let her wear herself out.
The schedule planner is right over there. I'll be relying on you these next two weeks.

quests.description: A ballet named “The Black Snow Swan” is becoming the center of attention. Yet, strange sounds of conversation drift through The Korolevskiy Theater’s walls…
